# betterado_securityrole_definitions (Data Source)

Use this data source to access information about Security Role Definitions in a given scope within Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up security role definitions for a given scope
data "betterado_securityrole_definitions" "environment" {
  scope = "distributedtask.environmentreferencerole"
}

output "environment_roles" {
  value = data.betterado_securityrole_definitions.environment.definitions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) The scope of the security role definitions to look up.

### Read-Only

- `definitions` (Attributes Set) Set of security role definitions found at the given scope. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definitions))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--definitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definitions`

Read-Only:

- `allow_permissions` (Number) Bitmask of permissions the role allows.
- `deny_permissions` (Number) Bitmask of permissions the role denies.
- `description` (String) A description of the role.
- `display_name` (String) The human-readable display name of the role.
- `identifier` (String) The unique identifier of the role definition.
- `name` (String) The internal name of the role.
- `scope` (String) The scope of the role definition.
